DKS/NKE do NOT print this week. RATES: 2Y 4.34% and climbing — it is the desk's only boss. VIX 15.77 (+9% off Friday), SPY call skew rich (Sep18 C 14.5% vs P 10.1%) — crowd buying upside, not protection. TILT: DEFENSIVE, 2nd straight session — hawkish repricing plus a war tax on the consumer beats chasing duration into an event minefield. XLP ballast; XLF NIM story intact but the short 57/56 puts are getting marked — size discipline. Tech is an event minefield tonight through Thursday: defined risk only, no new short premium, chase nothing above its 50-day. ISM at 10:00 is today's whole story — trade the reaction, not the headline. Read the tape, not the remarks. — Ernie
